data.one_liner: Framework to detect memory leaks in Dart and Flutter applications
data.what_it_does: LeakTracker hooks into the Dart VM service to record object allocations and report leaks. It provides configuration for ignored objects, custom error messages, and integration with test helpers.
use_when: Running CI tests that need to catch leaks
avoid_when: Production releases where runtime overhead matters
Environments without access to vm_service (e.g., web)
strengths: Comprehensive leak detection via VM service
Configurable ignored objects and error messages
Supports test helpers and custom baselining
weaknesses: Requires vm_service, not usable on web
Adds dependency on Dart VM service which may increase bundle size
data.setup_notes: Add leak_tracker to pubspec, import package, call LeakTracking.initialize() in main or test setup. No build_runner needed.
